# Security

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do **not** open a public issue. Report privately:

- **GitHub private reporting**: Use the repository's private vulnerability reporting form at https://github.com/jonasotoaguilar/raguard/security/advisories/new.
- **Contact**: If private reporting is unavailable, contact `PLACEHOLDER_security_contact` with the details below.

## What to include

- Affected project and version.
- Vulnerability description and impact.
- Reproduction steps.
- Proof of concept (if available).

## Response timeline

| Step | Expected timeframe |
|------|--------------------|
| Acknowledgment | 48 hours |
| Triage & assessment | 5 business days |
| Fix release | 30 days |

## Supported versions

| Version | Supported |
|---------|-----------|
| 0.1.x (latest release) | ✅ |
| Earlier versions | ❌ |
